ITINERARY

The trip rhythm.
Daily departure.

Next: upcoming departure. Daily departures. Tungnath / Chandrashila flex for snow and temple access.

Download itinerary PDF Day-by-day outline — ready to share.

  1. Depart · Road to Garhwal

    • Evening leave from Jaipur or Delhi NCR.
    • Overnight road toward Chopta belt (via Rishikesh / Devprayag corridor as routed).
    • Coordinator details shared before departure.

  2. Arrive · Chopta meadows

    • Check-in to camp/guesthouse, lunch and rest.
    • Easy meadow walks and acclimatisation.
    • Bonfire / group dinner when weather allows.

  3. Trek · Tungnath & Chandrashila

    • Early trek to Tungnath (highest Shiva temple) and optional Chandrashila summit.
    • Snow and ice common in winter — host may turn back for safety.
    • Return to Chopta overnight.

  4. Return · Plains

    • Optional Deoria Tal / local viewpoint if time.
    • Board return coach with overnight drive.
    • Delhi NCR morning window — flexible.

BEFORE YOU JOIN

Included & not promised.

Meadow stay and Tungnath day are planned. Summit success and lake detours are never guaranteed.

Included

  • Breakfast and dinner
  • Shared coach / Tempo Traveller class vehicle
  • Jaipur or Delhi NCR pickup coordination
  • Chopta-area stay + Tungnath trek day

Not promised

  • Open Chandrashila in heavy snow
  • Temple access during extreme weather
  • Paid adventure add-ons
  • Fixed return minute

Good to know

Winter ice.

Microspikes / good soles help on Tungnath steps.

Start early.

Summit windows are short — follow the host timing.

Altitude.

Go slow above Chopta; turn around if the group pace says so.
